caseNameFull: Andrew Anthony BROWN v. William P. BARR, Attorney General of the United States.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the *2663Eleventh Circuit. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit for further consideration in light of the confession of error by the Solicitor General in his brief for the respondent filed on March 6, 2020.
